progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on Ek in Zamineye Hoseyni. The line peaks at G4 (381.6 Hz) at 0:13.1. It closes on D3, not the tonic (C4 → C4 → D4 → D4 → D4 → D3).
